What is Orbit Kick?

Orbit Kick is a casual one-button soccer game where the goal isn’t to win matches but to kick the ball as far as possible. Aim to kick perfect shots to send the ball the greatest distance possible, earn coins based on distances covered, and purchase upgrades to send the ball even further. Each time you hit milestones like 1000 m, 2000 m, or 3000 m, you unlock a new level with exciting landmarks revealed, like Russia, Egypt, Brazil, and more, adding extra fun to the journey!

How to Play Orbit Kick

The game revolves primarily around this loop: kick or shoot the ball, earn coins based on its distance, and purchase upgrades with those coins. Keep kicking the ball and spending on upgrades to send the ball farther, soaring above the skies and ultimately reaching orbit.

Timing is everything

Each round begins with your character stepping up to kick the soccer ball. Keep an eye on the power meter, aiming to click or tap at the right moment to let it fly with the maximum power and the perfect straight angle. This ensures minimal risk of colliding with obstacles along the path that could stop its movement. Again, remember that the better your timing, the farther the ball will soar across the field.

Earn coins and unlock upgrades

The distance your ball travels is instantly converted into coins. These coins are your key to progress, allowing you to purchase powerful upgrades between kicks. In Orbit Kick, upgrades focus on 3 key things: kick power, the ball’s bounciness, and even offline earnings. Spend your coins strategically to help the ball hit the best distance ever.

Level up and continue the journey in Orbit Kick

As you hit distance milestones, you’ll level up your player. Each level unlocks new cities to explore and improved stats, such as stronger shot power and higher earnings for upcoming attempts.

Pro Hacks to Strike the Ball Farther

The farther your ball goes in Orbit Kick, the more exciting the journey becomes. Keep pushing your limits, unlock fresh areas, and discover new challenges that make every kick more rewarding. Here are some tips that help send the ball incredible distances:

Master timing. Observe the power meter and aim for the perfect zone. It doesn't depend entirely on luck but on your sense of timing when you click.

Upgrade smartly. Boosting kick strength gives the biggest early advantage, so prioritize it, then bounciness, before focusing on offline earnings.

Aim to hit the goal. Score goals to earn double coins! This helps you rack up points faster and unlock upgrades more quickly, though you’ll need a bit of luck to make it happen.

Stay consistent. Keep playing, and then you will boost your speed and other stats to reach farther and farther distances after all. Be patient and focus on improving your timing to let the ball soar up.

Orbit Kicks vs Other Games

Looking for an arcade sports game that’s simple, unique, relaxing, and perfect for both quick breaks and long sessions? Orbit Kicks is exactly the game. No competitive matches or opponents; it's just you, your ball, and the thrill of kicking it as far as you can.

If you love Orbit Kick or are simply a big fan of soccer games, here are some titles to consider. Each, of course, delivers unique gameplay features:

Soccer Skills Euro Cup: Focuses on competitive matches and strategy.
Football Legends: Multiplayer battles with characters and special moves.
Ball Orbit and Perfect Orbit: The two casual games with similar gameplay to Orbit Kick, but they feature baseball and golf mechanics, respectively.

FAQs
How do I play Orbit Kick unblocked?

Just head to Orbitkick.io and enjoy the game for free online right away; no downloads, sign-ups, or installs are needed.

Does Orbit Kick have leaderboards?

No, the game doesn’t currently have a leaderboard. It’s all about your farthest distance reached.

Can I pause or save progress in Orbit Kick?

Yes. You can stop the game anytime by closing the browser. Your progress is saved automatically, so you can continue your journey later on the same browser and device.

How do I get higher scores in Orbit Kick?

Time your kick at peak power and the perfect angle to launch the ball excellently. Upgrading your character early is also key.

Ready to Kick the Ball?

Are you ready to explore exotic landmarks across the globe? Start kicking your ball in Orbit Kick, push past obstacles, and see how far you can go! Play now on Orbitkick.io and have fun!
